verdict.rationale: A consumer password manager could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so this axis applies, but the evidence pack documents none in Proton Pass. The only AI mentions concern Proton Sentinel's account-protection analysis. That is an adjacent security feature, not an assistant users can hand tasks to. The CLI is a scripting tool, not an AI assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
